rows.title: Offer for sale
rows.summary: The President of India, acting through the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India has informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale upto 36,20,56,051 Equity shares of face value of INR 10/- each of Central Bank of India. Date and time of the opening of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: May 22, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: May 22, 2026 at 3:30 p.m.; Date and time of the opening of the offer for Retail Investors: May 25, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Retail Investors: May 25, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. The Sale shall continue to take place on a separate window of the Stock Exchanges commencing at 9:15 a.m. and shall close at 3:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on the same date. The Floor Price for the Offer shall be INR 31/- (Rupees Thirty One Only)
